sloka: संनिरुद्धग्रहगणमावारितनिशाकरम् ।विप्रनष्टानलमरुद्भास्करद्युतिसंवृतम्।यद्व -संनिरुद्ध ग्रह गणम् आवारित निशा करम् ।विप्रनष्ट अनल मरुत् भास्कर द्युति संवृतम् ॥३-६४-६०॥
transliteration: saṁniruddhagrahagaṇamāvāritaniśākaram ।vipranaṣṭānalamarudbhāskaradyutisaṁvṛtam।yadva -saṁniruddha graha gaṇam āvārita niśā karam ।vipranaṣṭa anala marut bhāskara dyuti saṁvṛtam ॥3-64-60॥

translations.english: I will obstruct the movement of planets and the Moon, destroy the radiance of the Sun, the fire and block the wind crush the mountain tops, dry up the tanks, destroy the trees shrubs and creepers and annihilate the oceans. I shall bring about this fatal change at once in the three worlds.
